title: Customer Account Manager
description:
Customer Account Manager

29,000 - 32,000 + Commission + Training + Long-Term Stability + Excellent Company Benefits

Ideally Located: Bournemouth, Christchurch, Poole, Wimborne, Ferndown, Ringwood, Wareham, Swanage, Dorchester

Are you an Account Manager or customer-focused professional looking for a stable, office-based role where you can build strong customer relationships, manage existing accounts and become a key part of a successful team?

This is a permanent position with a well-established business that offers full training, long-term stability and the opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and collaborative environment.

The company has continued to grow and is now looking for a Customer Account Manager to support their existing customer base and help maintain the high level of service they are known for.

You will be responsible for managing customer accounts, handling enquiries and quotes, resolving issues and working closely with internal teams to ensure customers receive an excellent level of service. You will also have a commercial focus, identifying opportunities within existing accounts and making sure nothing is missed.

This role would suit an Account Manager, Customer Service Executive or similar professional who is highly organised, good with customers and comfortable managing multiple priorities within a busy office environment.

The Role:
- Manage existing customer accounts and build strong, long-term relationships
- Handle enquiries, quotes, queries and customer issues, ensuring they are dealt with efficiently
- Work closely with customers and internal teams to provide an excellent level of service and identify opportunities

The Candidate:
- Account Management, Customer Service or similar experience
- Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and a busy inbox
- Commercially aware, solution-focused and confident communicating with customers and colleagues

Reference Number: BBBH (phone number removed)

title: Customer Operations Coordinator
description:
Customer Operations Coordinator

Location: Bournemouth
Salary: 28,000 to 31,000 per annum
Job Type: Full Time Permanent

About the Role

TeamJobs are recruiting for a Customer Service Executive to join a well established and growing business based in Bournemouth.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys delivering exceptional customer service in a fast paced environment. You'll be responsible for supporting customers throughout their journey, managing enquiries, coordinating appointments and working closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Benefits
- 28,000 to 31,000 per annum
- 33 days annual leave including Bank Holidays
- Company pension
- Company sick pay
- Career development and progression opportunities
- Employee referral programme
- Performance related salary reviews
- Company events and team socials
- Free flu jabs
- Eye care vouchers
- Monday to Friday working
- Modern office environment

The Role

As a Customer Service Executive, you will be the main point of contact for customers, ensuring they receive a first class service from enquiry through to resolution. You'll liaise with customers, engineers and internal teams to coordinate appointments, resolve issues and keep customers informed every step of the way.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond to customer enquiries via telephone and email.
- Deliver a professional and friendly customer experience.
- Coordinate appointments and schedule engineers where required.
- Manage customer cases from enquiry through to resolution.
- Keep customers updated throughout the process.
- Liaise with internal departments to resolve queries efficiently.
- Support customers with technical and operational enquiries.
- Build strong relationships with customers and contractors.
- Maintain accurate records using the company's CRM system.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:
- At least two years' experience within a customer service, customer support or operations role.
- Excellent communication and telephone skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A proactive approach to problem solving.
- The ability to remain calm and professional in a busy environment.
- A positive, team focused attitude.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office, and confidence using CRM systems.

Apply Today

If you're looking to join a growing business where you can develop your career and make a real difference to the customer experience, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact TeamJobs for more information.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Customer Service Administrator
Location: Bournemouth
Salary: £26,000 DOE
Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday
Working hours: 8:00am 4:30pm or 8:30am 5:00pm

Tru Talent is delighted to be working with a well-established and growing waste management company in Bournemouth, who are looking for an experienced Customer Service Administrator to join their team.

This is a varied and important role, combining customer service, administration and coordination to help ensure the smooth running of day-to-day operations.

We re looking for someone who is organised, proactive and confident communicating with customers, suppliers and internal teams. You ll be a strong team player who is also comfortable using your own initiative and taking ownership of tasks.

As a Customer Service Administrator, your responsibilities will include:
- Handling operational calls professionally and efficiently
- Building strong relationships with customers and suppliers
- Managing customer accounts and dealing with queries
- Processing orders and liaising with suppliers
- Advising customers on commercial and domestic waste services
- Supporting customer accounts and processing payments
- Managing contractor pricing and purchase orders
- Assisting with new site set-ups
- Keeping internal systems and records accurate and up to date
- Communicating important information across different teams
- Resolving customer queries and issues promptly and effectively
- Providing general administrative support to the Customer Service team
- Supporting other departments when required

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service and administration role
- Hospitality experience will also be considered
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- A confident and professional telephone manner
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word
- The ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple tasks
- A proactive approach with the ability to work independently
- Previous experience within the waste management or construction industry would be preferred, but is not essential

Click Apply Now to take the next step in your career.

title: Operations Assistant
description:
Service Operations Coordinator - EV Infrastructure

Location: Bournemouth Airport
Job Type: Full-time, Temporary on going (opportunity to go permanent)

Pay: 13.96
Working Hours: 8.5-hour shifts between 7:00am and 6:00pm, including a 1-hour unpaid lunch break

TeamJobs are recruiting for a Service Operations Coordinator to join a busy and growing team supporting Electric Vehicle Infrastructure (EVI) customers.

This is a varied coordination and administration role, where you will be responsible for managing faults and incidents, coordinating engineer attendance and ensuring customers are kept up to date throughout the process.

The role:
- Coordinating and managing EV infrastructure faults and incidents
- Dispatching and scheduling Field Service Engineers
- Prioritising engineer workloads and responding to urgent faults
- Keeping internal systems updated with the latest fault information
- Chasing engineers for updates and attendance details
- Communicating with customers and providing progress updates
- Working to agreed Service Level Agreements
- Monitoring fault management systems and interfaces
- Supporting the implementation of new EV infrastructure customers and processes
- Attending customer meetings where required
- Maintaining up-to-date contract and customer documentation
- Escalating issues where necessary and taking ownership of incidents through to completion

What we are looking for:
- Previous administration, coordination or customer service experience
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel
- A proactive and positive approach to problem-solving
- Ability to build strong relationships with colleagues, engineers and customers
- Confidence working independently and managing tasks through to completion

Experience within EV infrastructure or a technical environment would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Location and hybrid working

The role will initially be based in Poole, before relocating to the Bournemouth Airport area from October 2026.

For the first six months, the role will be fully office-based whilst training is completed. Following successful completion of training, there will be the opportunity to work on a hybrid basis, with three shifts per week based in the office.

Please note: Due to the shift times and future location, candidates must be able to reliably travel to the Bournemouth Airport site without relying on public transport.

If you are an organised and proactive coordinator looking for a varied role within the growing electric vehicle infrastructure sector, we would love to hear from you!

TJCOM
